scenarios.title: Technical recommendation requiring measurements that are not available (Regression Test)
scenarios.input_topic: Response generation latency in live audio pipeline
flawed_warnings: Unsupported numeric recommendation: ungrounded metric/threshold '270 ms' not present in conversation context.
Unsupported recommendation: proposes ungrounded safety margin without empirical calibration.
scenarios.grounded_text: The 50 ms VAD and 180 ms Whisper times are participant estimates. We should measure the end-of-speech silence detection threshold before fixing an LLM latency budget.
scenarios.notes: Flawed response with invented numbers (270 ms, 100 ms) and safety margin rejected; grounded response recommending measurement accepted.

before_after_comparisons.before_experiment_2: Silero VAD's 50 ms and Whisper Tiny's 180 ms leave about 270 ms for the LLM; add a brief safety margin of ~100 ms to ensure smooth delivery.
before_issues: Invented ungrounded 270 ms LLM budget assuming an unmentioned 500 ms SLA.
Invented ~100 ms safety margin with no empirical basis in conversation.
Treated participant estimates (50 ms VAD, 180 ms Whisper) as global benchmarks.
before_after_comparisons.after_grounded: The 50 ms VAD and 180 ms Whisper times are participant estimates. We should measure the end-of-speech silence detection threshold before fixing an LLM latency budget.
after_improvements: Explicitly identifies numbers as participant estimates.
Recommends empirical calibration of silence detection threshold instead of inventing margins.

before_after_comparisons.before: Paraphrased suggestions on identical underlying ideas (e.g., 'enforce 16 kHz mono PCM' vs 'require 16 kHz mono PCM') both accepted because strings differed.
before_after_comparisons.after: Validator tokenizes content and measures Jaccard similarity and containment overlap (>0.50), rejecting redundant recommendations even with varied vocabulary.

before_after_comparisons.before: 'Consider reviewing the asynchronous event pipeline latency metrics.' (empty platitude accepted).
before_after_comparisons.after: Deterministic regex and semantic checks reject boilerplate platitudes; requires actionable technical contribution.

remaining_limitations: Heuristic token-containment overlap handles single-topic paraphrasing well, but deeply metaphorical synonyms without token overlap may require semantic embedding checks.
Numeric extraction allows conversational cardinal numbers (1, 2) and context-stated numbers; non-standard scientific notation would require regex expansion.
Offline validation uses deterministic test mocks; live model inference will still require the generator node prompt constraints to maintain high yield.
